question: Hema Malini, a well-known Bharatnatyam dancer and Bollywood actor, received which of the following honours of Indian civilians given by the Government of India in 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hema Malini** (born 16 October 1948) is an **Indian actress**, director, producer, and politician.
 
• She is primarily known for her work **in Hindi films,** Known for starring in both comic and dramatic roles.
 
• she is one of **the most popular and successful leading actresses of mainstream** .
 
• She is known **as Dream Girl of Hindi cinema.**
 
• She was **honoured **with the **Padma Shri**, the fourth-highest civilian honour awarded by the Government of India in **2000**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​ **Bharat Ratna** is awarded to a person as a recognition of exceptional service or performance in any field of the Indian endeavour.
 
• **Padma Bhushan **is awarded for the exceptional and distinguished service in Architecture ,medicine and public affairs.
